outcome: Uterine aspiration for indications other than ongoing pregnancy
cohort: The study included 14,504 patient encounters of individuals receiving medication abortion with mifepristone and buccal or vaginal misoprostol between September 1, 2017 and August 1, 2019.
finding: Buccal administration of misoprostol is associated with a higher proportion of complete abortion before 64 days of gestation compared to vaginal misoprostol.
gest_age: Up to 70 days of gestation, with analysis stratified by <64 days and 64-70 days of gestation.
